visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium shot of a young woman with long dark hair, wearing a brown blazer, a red and navy argyle sweater vest, and brown shorts. She stands in a bright indoor studio, holding a large black PRADA box with both hands while smiling and speaking. Behind her, a white shelf displays various paint tubes, and colorful abstract paintings lean against the wall. (2) She turns and walks slightly, holding the black box and a green folder under her arm, moving towards the side of the room. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the clean, minimalist interior of the studio. (3) She opens the box on a surface, revealing a beige handbag inside light blue protective paper. She holds up a small white envelope with her name written on it towards the camera, maintaining an excited facial expression. (4) The woman holds the beige PRADA bag, which has a soft, wrinkled leather texture and a buckled strap across the middle. She demonstrates the bag's flexibility by pulling the sides, focusing on the central pleat detail while gesturing with her hands. (5) A series of modeling shots follow where she wears the bag, turning around to show it from different angles. She also appears in an outdoor setting with white stairs and greenery, wearing a white shirt and the same beige bag, posing with a confident gaze.
